loginCode.subject: Your INFLUX sign-in code
loginCode.preheader: Valid for 10 minutes, in the tab where you requested it.
loginCode.title: Your sign-in code
loginCode.codeIntro: Enter this code on the INFLUX screen where you requested it:
loginCode.phraseHelp: It must be identical to the one shown on that screen. If it is different, do not enter this code.
loginCode.validity: This code is valid for 10 minutes and can be used once, only in the tab where you requested it.
loginCode.context: Request received on {requestedAt, date, long} at {requestedAt, time, short} ({timeZone}) from {browser}.
loginCode.contextNoBrowser: Request received on {requestedAt, date, long} at {requestedAt, time, short} ({timeZone}).
loginCode.notYou: Didn't request anything? Ignore this email: without this code, no one can sign in to INFLUX with your address.
loginCode.never: INFLUX will never ask you for this code, by phone, email or message. Do not share it with anyone.
loginCode.reason: a sign-in code was requested for this address on INFLUX

emailChangeConfirmOld.subject: Confirm the change of address of your INFLUX account
emailChangeConfirmOld.preheader: Code valid for 24 hours, to enter in your INFLUX space.
emailChangeConfirmOld.title: Change of address: confirmation from your current address
emailChangeConfirmOld.codeIntro: Enter this code in your INFLUX space, at the “current address” step:
emailChangeConfirmOld.validity: This code is valid for 24 hours. The change only takes place once it is also confirmed from the new address; until then, you still sign in with this address.
emailChangeConfirmOld.context: Request received on {requestedAt, date, long} at {requestedAt, time, short} ({timeZone}).
emailChangeConfirmOld.notYou: Didn't request anything? Do not enter this code, and sign out of all your sessions from your INFLUX space: without this code, the address of your account cannot change.
emailChangeConfirmOld.never: INFLUX will never ask you for this code, by phone, email or message. Do not share it with anyone.
emailChangeConfirmOld.reason: a change of the address of your INFLUX account was requested

emailChangeConfirmNew.subject: Confirm your new INFLUX address
emailChangeConfirmNew.preheader: Code valid for 24 hours, to enter in your INFLUX space.
emailChangeConfirmNew.title: Change of address: confirmation from your new address
emailChangeConfirmNew.codeIntro: Enter this code in your INFLUX space, at the “new address” step:
emailChangeConfirmNew.validity: This code is valid for 24 hours. Once both confirmations are made, you will sign in with this address.
emailChangeConfirmNew.context: Request received on {requestedAt, date, long} at {requestedAt, time, short} ({timeZone}).
emailChangeConfirmNew.notYou: Didn't request anything? Ignore this email: without this code, your address cannot be attached to an INFLUX account.
emailChangeConfirmNew.never: INFLUX will never ask you for this code, by phone, email or message. Do not share it with anyone.
emailChangeConfirmNew.reason: this address was given as the new address of an INFLUX account

newDevice.subject: New sign-in to your INFLUX account
newDevice.preheader: From {browser}. If this was you, there is nothing to do.
newDevice.title: New sign-in from a new browser
newDevice.body: Someone signed in to your INFLUX account on {signedInAt, date, long} at {signedInAt, time, short} ({timeZone}) from {browser}. This browser had not been used on your account in the last 30 days.
newDevice.ifYou: If this was you, there is nothing to do.
newDevice.step1: First secure your email inbox (change its password): it is where your sign-in codes arrive.
newDevice.step2: Sign in to INFLUX, open "My sessions" and choose "Close all sessions".
newDevice.step3: If you cannot sign in, contact INFLUX from the help on the sign-in screen.
newDevice.never: INFLUX will never ask you for your sign-in code.
newDevice.reason: someone signed in to your INFLUX account from a new browser

previous.subject: The address of your INFLUX account has changed
previous.preheader: This address is no longer the one of your INFLUX account.
previous.title: Your account address has changed
previous.body: The change of email address of your INFLUX account, confirmed from this address and from the new one, is now in effect. This address can no longer be used to sign in, and we will no longer write to it.
previous.notYou: You did not make this change?
previous.step1: First secure your mailbox (change its password).
previous.step2: Report it to INFLUX from the help of the sign-in screen, giving the date of this email.
previous.never: INFLUX will never ask you for your sign-in code.
previous.reason: the address of your INFLUX account has just changed

current.subject: This address is now the one of your INFLUX account
current.preheader: Use it to sign in to INFLUX.
current.title: Address change in effect
current.body: The change of email address of your INFLUX account is now in effect: you now sign in with this address, and this is where we write to you.
current.notYou: You did not make this change?
current.step1: Sign in to INFLUX, open "My sessions" and choose "Close all sessions".
current.step2: Report it to INFLUX from the help of the sign-in screen, giving the date of this email.
current.never: INFLUX will never ask you for your sign-in code.
current.reason: the address of your INFLUX account has just changed

subject.access: Your INFLUX data export request has been received
subject.erasure: Your INFLUX account deletion request has been received

requestReceived.preheader: A member of the INFLUX team will handle it. You will hear from us by {dueAt, date, long} at the latest.

received.access: We have received your request for an export of your personal data, submitted from your INFLUX account on {receivedAt, date, long} at {receivedAt, time, short} ({timeZone}).
received.erasure: We have received your request to delete your INFLUX account, submitted from your account on {receivedAt, date, long} at {receivedAt, time, short} ({timeZone}).

next.access: Nothing is sent automatically: a member of the INFLUX team handles your request and prepares a readable file with the personal data we hold about you. We will tell you how to retrieve it securely; it will never be sent as an email attachment.
next.erasure: Nothing is deleted automatically: a member of the INFLUX team handles your request. Until then, your account remains active and you can still sign in.

kept.erasure: Some information is not erased but kept in a form that no longer names you, for example the activity log and the record of your acceptance of the terms of use. Our reply will tell you exactly what was deleted, what is kept, and why.

requestReceived.deadline: We will reply to this address by {dueAt, date, long} at the latest.
requestReceived.followUp: You can follow this request in your INFLUX account, under "My data".
requestReceived.notYou: Didn't make this request? It was confirmed with a code sent to this address:
requestReceived.step1: First secure your email inbox (change its password).
requestReceived.step2: Sign in to INFLUX, open "My sessions" and choose "Close all sessions".
requestReceived.step3: Then report it to INFLUX from the help on the sign-in screen, giving the date of the request.
requestReceived.never: INFLUX will never ask you for your sign-in code.
requestReceived.reason: a request about your personal data was submitted from your INFLUX account

exportReady.subject: Your INFLUX data export is available
exportReady.preheader: Download it from your INFLUX account, under "My data", until {expiresAt, date, long}.
exportReady.title: Your data export is ready
exportReady.available: The file of the personal data we hold about you is available in your INFLUX account, under "My data", until {expiresAt, date, long} at {expiresAt, time, short} ({timeZone}).
exportReady.howTo: For each download, a code is sent to this address to confirm that it is you. The file can be downloaded three times at most; it is then erased, and you can always make a new request.
exportReady.content: The file is in JSON format: readable, and reusable by another application. It contains a notice explaining, for each category of data, why we hold it and how long we keep it.
exportReady.noAttachment: This file is never sent by email, and this email contains no link: sign in to INFLUX as usual.
exportReady.notYou: Didn't request this export? It was confirmed with a code sent to this address:
exportReady.reason: you requested an export of your personal data from your INFLUX account

criticalAlert.subject: INFLUX — Alerte critique / Critical alert
criticalAlert.title: INFLUX critical alert
criticalAlert.breakGlassLogin: Sign-in to the backoffice break-glass account.
criticalAlert.recoveryCodeConsumed: Backoffice sign-in with a recovery code. Codes left on this account: {remaining}.
criticalAlert.occurredAt: On {occurredAt, date, long} at {occurredAt, time, medium} (UTC).

technicalAlert.heading: INFLUX technical alert
technicalAlert.openedAt: Raised on {openedAt, date, long} at {openedAt, time, medium} (UTC).
technicalAlert.observedAt: Observed on {observedAt, date, long} at {observedAt, time, medium} (UTC).

targets.api_health: /health of the API (private network, checks the database)

groups.digest: Digest of the new server error groups of the last 24 hours: {count}.
groups.line: {errorType} on {route} — group {id}, on {at, date, long} at {at, time, medium} (UTC)

AL48.title: Sign-in code deliverability out of bounds
AL48.measure: Codes sent in the window: {sends}. Median delay: {medianDeliverySeconds} s; 9 cases out of 10: {p90DeliverySeconds} s; requests without a sign-in within 10 min: {noSignInShare}; delivered share: {deliveredShare}.
AL48.action: Incident: people cannot get into their account. Check Brevo and the sending domain.

AL49.title: Site unreachable
AL49.measure: Target: {target}. Consecutive failures: {consecutiveFailures} (threshold: {threshold}). Last failure: {failureCode}, HTTP status {statusCode}.
AL49.action: Check Railway and Supabase; roll back to the previous version if the failure follows a deployment.

AL50.title: Worker stopped
AL50.measure: Last beat: {lastBeatAt} ({ageSeconds} s ago; threshold: {thresholdSeconds} s).
AL50.action: Read its "fatal" line in the Railway logs (missing setting), then restart the worker service.

AL51.title: New server error or regression
AL51.action: Classify each group: fixed, planned or harmless.

AL52.title: Server error rate
AL52.measure: {serverErrors} 5xx responses out of {requests} in {windowMinutes} min, that is {share} (threshold: {threshold}).
AL52.action: Find the route at fault; fix it or roll back to the previous version.

AL53.title: Slow API
AL53.measure: p95 of the API over {windowMinutes} min: {p95}, on {requests} requests (threshold: {thresholdMs} ms, code requests excluded).
AL53.action: Read the slowdown: call spike, slow query, database or external provider.

AL54.title: Slow pages
AL54.measure: {target}: {durationMs} ms at the last probe, beyond {thresholdMs} ms on {probes} consecutive probes.
AL54.action: Read the slowdown: call spike, slow query, database or external provider.

AL55.title: Call spike (information)
AL55.measure: {callsPerMinute} calls per minute over 5 min; usual volume: {usualCallsPerMinute}; limit: {limit}.
AL55.action: Match it with its origin (e-mail send, campaign); act only if a slowdown follows.

AL56.title: Rising 429 responses
AL56.measure: {throttled} 429 responses out of {requests} in {windowMinutes} min, that is {share} (threshold: {threshold} and at least {minCount}).
AL56.action: Look for abuse before raising a limit.

AL57.title: Saturated service
AL57.measure: Service {service}: average event loop delay {avgEventLoopDelayMs} ms over {windowMinutes} min (threshold: {thresholdMs} ms); memory: {memoryShare}.
AL57.action: Increase the Railway resources; look for the loop or the leak.

AL58.title: Saturated database
AL58.measure: Database connections: {connections} out of {maxConnections} (threshold: {threshold} on {samples} consecutive samples).
AL58.action: Look for the connections and the long queries.

AL59.title: Targeted sign-in code
AL59.measure: {failures} code failures in 24 hours for one address (threshold: {threshold}). Nothing is blocked.
AL59.action: Investigate: targeted attack or member in difficulty.

AL60.title: Hourly purge at fault
AL60.measure: Run {runId} finished on {finishedAt}: {realignFailed} failed GoTrue realignment(s); breaker: {breaker}.
AL60.action: Examine the run and fix it before the next one.

AL61.title: Brevo webhook: ignored calls
AL61.measure: {ignored} ignored calls out of {authenticated} authenticated calls in {windowHours} h, that is {share} (threshold: {threshold}).
AL61.action: Read the main reason: a changed Brevo format loses unsubscriptions.

AL62.title: Brevo webhook outside its ranges
AL62.measure: {occurrences} call(s) with a valid token received outside the ranges published by Brevo; last: {lastAt}.
AL62.action: Update the ranges if Brevo changed them, otherwise change the token.

AL63.title: Executed personal data request not closed
AL63.measure: Execution {executionId}, executed on {executedAt}, not closed beyond {thresholdHours} h.
AL63.action: Complete and close it: the legal deadline runs.

welcomeAdvertiser.subject: Welcome to INFLUX
welcomeAdvertiser.preheader: Your brand account is ready. Here is how INFLUX works.
welcomeAdvertiser.title: Welcome to INFLUX
welcomeAdvertiser.intro: Your brand account is ready. INFLUX connects you with content creators for your campaigns.
welcomeAdvertiser.how: You discover creators through anonymised profiles. Every introduction is approved by an INFLUX account manager, then accepted by both sides: only then does the conversation open and are identities revealed.
welcomeAdvertiser.together: Your INFLUX account manager supports you at every step, from the first exchange to the contract. Everything happens in INFLUX, where your conversations remain available.
welcomeAdvertiser.signIn: To sign in, enter your email address on INFLUX: we send you a 6-digit code. There is no password.
welcomeAdvertiser.never: INFLUX will never ask you for your sign-in code.
welcomeAdvertiser.reason: you have just created a brand account on INFLUX

welcomeCreator.subject: Welcome to INFLUX
welcomeCreator.preheader: Your creator account is ready. Here is how INFLUX works.
welcomeCreator.title: Welcome to INFLUX
welcomeCreator.intro: Your creator account is ready. INFLUX connects you with brands looking for creators for their paid campaigns.
welcomeCreator.how: Brands discover your profile in an anonymised form, and you can apply to their campaigns. Every introduction is approved by an INFLUX account manager, then accepted by both sides: only then does the conversation open and are identities revealed.
welcomeCreator.together: Your INFLUX account manager supports you at every step and tells you what you earn for each collaboration. Everything happens in INFLUX, where your conversations remain available.
welcomeCreator.signIn: To sign in, enter your email address on INFLUX: we send you a 6-digit code. There is no password.
welcomeCreator.never: INFLUX will never ask you for your sign-in code.
welcomeCreator.reason: you have just created a creator account on INFLUX
